method: Duplicate groups found from the id list, then claims and quotes compared per group (awk read-outs of data/facts/*.jsonl). Decisions in reg-decisions.md. Every change applied one saa.py command at a time (facts amend --supersede, facts amend --file with patches in reg-disp/, facts adopt). facts verify --chapter 28 afterwards: 707 checked, 707 ok.
rules_applied: Duplicates: 79 superseded where two or more facts quote the same sentence (or the same table row) or state the same meaning; the kept fact has the cleaner quote, more displays or a FAQ source (FAQ facts kept for the quick-fire). Bundle facts whose claim went beyond their quotes were superseded by the single-sentence facts (entail risk).

Displays: about 180 facts amended so that every number-free display is a verbatim phrase of at most 8 words from a quote (RULINGS 2026-10-11); displays with Markdown italics replaced; displays of negative facts keep the negation word where possible (L303 link-text rule). One bold display kept (dax-can-subvert-dynamodb-iam-policies, verbatim).
hard: set true on 41 FAQ-lens capability and behavior facts that had hard false (can or supports claims), consistent with the guide-lens facts; 3 case-study facts without numbers stay hard false.

Scope: dynamodb-database-savings-plans-cover-dynamodb (up to 35%, plan-wide across database services) and dynamodb-faq-database-savings-plans-18-percent (up to 18% for DynamoDB usage) are both kept with explicit scope; dynamodb-global-table-replicas-share-name-key-data got the condition single-account (multi-account replicas may use other names).
Namespace: all dax-* facts are in service dax and all dynamodb-* facts in service dynamodb; no mismatch found.
